summary: A compact replication answer starts its differing-range listing by golden-ratio steps of the store's answer count, so a peer answered every few times still reaches every differing range instead of seeing the same few

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No API or wire changes; only the order in which an answer lists differing ranges changes.

downtime.detail: A daemon restart to install the build; no extra interruption.

recovery.detail: Swap back to the previous binary freely; nothing is persisted.
